description: This file defines the perf_mssql class, which provides performance monitoring and tuning functionalities specific to Microsoft SQL Server within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It includes SQL queries for performance metrics, methods for explaining query plans, retrieving table info, and system health checks.

classes.name: perf_mssql
classes.description: A class for performance monitoring and management specific to MS SQL Server within the ADOdb library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the perf_mssql instance and adjusts SQL query strings based on the connection's data provider.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan and performance details for a given SQL query, optionally filtering by a partial hash.

methods.name: Tables
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of user-defined tables with their sizes and index information.

methods.name: sp_who
methods.description: Returns the number of active sessions/users by executing the sp_who stored procedure.

methods.name: HealthCheck
methods.description: Performs a health check on the SQL Server by enabling trace flags, invoking the parent class's health check, and disabling trace flags.
